reason: The pet thing honestly sounds fun and I'd probably play with the free demo on my commute, but I'm not paying a monthly subscription just to invest when my broker app already lets me buy index funds for free. Signing up for a paid plan with no price on it is a pass.
objection: Paying a recurring fee on top of my investments eats into returns, and I'm not sure an AI pet rebalancing an index fund portfolio does anything I couldn't do myself in five minutes a month.
would_change_my_mind: If the demo showed me, with my own streak and record, that the agent actually beat what I do by more than the fee, and the price was a few bucks a month like Robinhood Gold, I'd think about it.
